text:
maria_support: FYI I'm escalating an enterprise report — customer sees duplicate POSTs when we return 503 from our upstream service. They say the Python SDK retried and the Idempotency-Key wasn't preserved, causing duplicate invoices. Repro snippet and observations below.

maria_support: Env details: py-sdk==0.6.2 (customer), tried 0.6.5 and saw different timing but still flaky. Occurs under medium concurrency (~10 rps).

maria_support: Repro (minimal):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryConfig
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.create_invoice(payload, idempotency_key="inv-123", retry_config=RetryConfig(max_retries=3, backoff_jitter=0))
```
They say when upstream returns 503 we sometimes get two successful side effects server-side even though the SDK is supposed to preserve Idempotency-Key.

sam_engineer: Thanks, Maria. Can you paste a request/response pair or raw HTTP headers? My hunch: a regression in how the retry wrapper reconstructs the request on exceptions — header propagation lost in the fast-path for HTTPError/TransportError. Also jitter=0 can exacerbate thundering-herd but shouldn't drop headers.

maria_support: Adding an anonymized capture:
```http
POST /v1/invoices HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.dev
Authorization: Bearer ****
Idempotency-Key: inv-123
Content-Type: application/json

HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 1

# client retried automatically and second attempt lacked Idempotency-Key header according to our server logs
```

sam_engineer: That matches what I suspected. We have an older bug where the request builder clones body but not some custom headers when the exception path triggers a "replay" body stream wrapper. If the idempotency header is set by the higher-level helper (create_invoice) it may not survive into the rebuilt PreparedRequest in 0.6.2.

ella_prod: We saw a similar issue in July — it was a state-machine bug in RetryPolicy where _prepare_retry_request() regenerated headers and overwrote Idempotency-Key with a new token when preserve_headers==False. Patch idea: only auto-generate idempotency key when it's absent, and ensure header propagation uses original_request.headers.copy(). I'll attach the quick fix.

ella_prod: Suggested short-term workaround for support: explicitly set idempotency_key per call (as they did) and set retry_config=RetryConfig(preserve_headers=True) if possible. We're going to make preserve_headers default to true in the next patch.

sam_engineer: Minimal stacktrace excerpt from a dev repro (local):
```
File ".../site-packages/redwood/http/retry.py", line 178, in _retry_request
  prepared = self._rebuild_prepared_request(req)
File ".../site-packages/redwood/http/retry.py", line 210, in _rebuild_prepared_request
  new_headers.update(getattr(req, 'meta_headers', {}))  # bug: meta_headers may be empty
AttributeError: 'Request' object has no attribute 'meta_headers'
```

sam_engineer: When that AttributeError is swallowed, we fall back to a new header set and lose Idempotency-Key. We'll add a robust copy and test.

ops_bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-459 — label: sdk-python, severity: P2, owner: @sam_engineer.

ella_prod: I'm opening PR with two commits: (1) preserve original_request.headers when rebuilding; (2) default preserve_headers=True and add unit tests for 429/503 + streaming bodies. Will run flaky test suite.

sam_engineer: Quick patch snippet I tested locally:
```diff
- new_headers = {}
- new_headers.update(getattr(req, 'meta_headers', {}))
+ new_headers = req.headers.copy() if hasattr(req, 'headers') else {}
+ new_headers.update(getattr(req, 'meta_headers', {}))
```
This keeps Idempotency-Key. Also added an integration test that asserts server only sees one create call when server returns 503 then 200.

maria_support: Great. Customer is happy to test a build — can you share a wheel or a branch? They need it for a compliance audit.

ella_prod: I'll push a preview wheel to the private s3 and post URL in the ticket in ~30m. Note: this only fixes header-drop on retry rebuild; if users explicitly rely on auto-generation semantics we should document the change.

sam_engineer: I'll follow up with a regression note in changelog and add a snippet in support KB about explicit idempotency_key and preserve_headers config.

maria_support: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and attach repro logs to #INC-2026-459.

ops_bot: Staging deploy scheduled: sdk-python/branch/repair-retry-headers at 2026-01-21T14:40:00Z (canary).
